players.product: RF and microwave plasma power generators and auto-matching units for semiconductor process equipment, and vacuum clean transfer robots for wafer handling

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026): orders received JPY 271,330 million (up 12.6%) and net sales JPY 237,735 million (up 5.0%), on higher capital investment by power-infrastructure and semiconductor-related companies; operating profit JPY 18,778 million (up 16.1%), ordinary profit JPY 20,100 million (up 17.0%) and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 14,108 million (up 18.0%), helped by higher sales and cost reductions.
quarterly_data.figure: orders JPY 271,330 million (+12.6%); net sales JPY 237,735 million (+5.0%); operating profit JPY 18,778 million (+16.1%); net income JPY 14,108 million (+18.0%)

quarterly_data.figure: order backlog JPY 142,946 million (130.7% YoY); Material Processing backlog JPY 26,515 million (188.7% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Material Processing segment (welding machines, plasma cutting machines, plasma-generation power supplies), FY2026: net sales JPY 76,426 million (up 5.2%) and operating profit JPY 7,422 million (up 6.3%); management states advanced-semiconductor investment stayed at a high level on rising demand for high-performance semiconductor devices for data centers as generative AI spreads. Segment production JPY 46,471 million (107.6% of the prior year, at selling prices).
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 76,426 million (+5.2%); operating profit JPY 7,422 million (+6.3%); production JPY 46,471 million (107.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: Energy Management segment (transformers, power receiving and substation equipment, switchgear, control and communication equipment, distributed power equipment and charging systems), FY2026: net sales JPY 128,220 million (up 6.1%) and operating profit JPY 14,165 million (up 23.4%), as replacement investment in domestic factory substation equipment held firm and demand for battery storage systems rose with the growing balancing-power market as renewable energy expands.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 128,220 million (+6.1%); operating profit JPY 14,165 million (+23.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Factory Automation segment (industrial robots, clean transfer robots), FY2026: net sales JPY 32,933 million (up 0.5%) as new-customer wins in the US and China offset continued postponement of automotive investment in Japan and Europe; operating profit JPY 1,971 million (down 13.4%) on fewer high-margin projects.

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 mid-term plan targets: for the company's fiscal 2026 (the year ending March 2027, FY2027), net sales of JPY 250 billion or more, operating margin 10% or more, ROE 12% or more and a development-cost ratio of 6% or more; for fiscal 2030 (FY2031), net sales of JPY 300 billion or more and an operating margin of 12% or more (ROE and development-cost ratio targets unchanged). Fiscal 2025 actuals (the year ended March 2026, FY2026): net sales JPY 237.7 billion, operating margin 7.9%, ROE 9.7%, development-cost ratio 4.1%.
quarterly_data.figure: targets: net sales JPY 250 billion+ and OP margin 10%+ (fiscal 2026, year ending March 2027); JPY 300 billion+ and 12%+ (fiscal 2030)

quarterly_data.signal: Management expects semiconductor-related investment to keep expanding on the spread of generative AI and rising data-center demand, demand for battery storage systems to grow with renewable adoption, and labor-saving / automation needs at production sites to stay firm, while noting uncertainty including the risk of higher raw-material prices from the Middle East situation. In Material Processing it is developing and launching high-performance, high-efficiency RF power supply systems for finer, multilayer and energy-saving semiconductor processes; in Factory Automation, transfer robots for advanced semiconductor packages.

FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 7,534 million (Energy Management JPY 3,688 million, Factory Automation JPY 852 million, Material Processing JPY 2,992 million). Material Processing worked on higher-performance RF power supply systems that achieve multilayer and fine processing compactly and with lower power, and on a plasma source for cleaning off excess film deposited in CVD (thin-film deposition) equipment for semiconductor manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 7,534 million; Material Processing JPY 2,992 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 Factory Automation R&D included a space-saving SCARA-arm vacuum transfer robot and low-vibration, low-floor, high-stroke atmospheric robots for advanced packages such as FOPLP, plus collaborative robots, an AI-equipped arc welding system and self-propelled robots combining collaborative robots and autonomous transport carts.

FY2026 capital expenditure totaled JPY 13,398 million (Energy Management JPY 8,527 million, Factory Automation JPY 995 million, Material Processing JPY 1,780 million, other JPY 8 million, corporate JPY 2,086 million), mainly plant construction to expand industrial-transformer production capacity, production-automation investment and seismic reinforcement work.
quarterly_data.figure: capex JPY 13,398 million (Material Processing JPY 1,780 million)
